stories.title: ‘Eat the rich, save the planet’: climate protesters call out big tech’s disconnect from reality
stories.summary: Climate activists protested outside OpenAI’s Manhattan offices during New York City’s climate week, carrying signs including “Eat the rich, save the planet.” Groups also picketed Google and Amazon offices over the following two days, while some protesters, including clergy, were arrested during a disruption.

links.excerpt: Activists gathered outside the OpenAI offices on Monday during climate week in New York City On Monday evening, protesters gathered outside the unmarked Manhattan offices of OpenAI, maker of ChatGPT, holding signs calling to “Eat the rich, save the planet”. stories.title: Hamas Took More Than 200 Hostages From Israel. Here's What We Know.
stories.summary: Hamas took more than 200 hostages from Israel on October 7. Israel says 91 abductees remain in captivity, including the bodies of at least 34 people.

stories.title: ‘Charming and disarming’ … how Meta’s technology-packed Muse harnesses the power of cuteness
stories.summary: Meta has introduced Muse, a charm-like device with a cute onscreen avatar that has drawn comparisons with Tamagotchis. The company says the device can handle tasks such as answering emails, booking travel and ordering groceries, presenting it as a friendlier alternative after criticism of its smart glasses.
